description:
Fractal Pokédex Ordinals is a collection of 1,025 unique Pokémon NFTs inscribed on the Fractal Bitcoin blockchain. Each token represents a different Pokémon, from Bulbasaur (#1) to Pecharunt (#1025), with its illustration, name, and key characteristics such as types, abilities, and battle stats.

This collection transforms the Pokédex into a verifiable and permanent digital experience. Each Pokémon is associated with a unique on-chain inscription, allowing for precise identification of its image, metadata, and ID. Fractal Pokédex thus unites the iconic Pokémon universe, digital collecting, and Bitcoin inscription technology in a comprehensive series of 1,025 tokens.
name: Fractal Pokédex Ordinals
